_about: Copy to $CLUPAI_HOME/guardrails.json (install.sh does this and expands ~, because dir must be an absolute path). Sessions add rules with `hooks/guardrails.py learn`. These are lessons of the kind sessions learn, with names removed.

rules.why: one shared staging: a second deploy mid-deploy clobbers the first; one session deploys at a time
pushing to the shared staging branch is part of the staging deploy; take the staging turn first
could break: production for all users. Prod needs owner sign-off and a quiet time window. Instead: confirm both with the user before deploying
could break: a deploy script rewrites a tracked config file in place, and commit -a picks it up. Instead: restore that file, then add files by name
could break: every deploy that mounts that secret at :latest. 'latest' is the highest version number even when it is disabled. Instead: add a new version first, then disable the old one
could break: commits carry AI co-author trailers the upstream project does not accept. Instead: rewrite the trailers, then open the PR
could break: the script uses --set-env-vars, which REPLACES the service's env and erases hand-set vars. Instead: use --update-env-vars, or re-add them after
